name: The Shillelagh
intro: An Irish-American gathering place in West Orange, New Jersey. Join us for live music, a pint, and a seat at the bar. Everyone is welcome.
story:
The Essex Division of the Friendly Sons of the Shillelagh dates to 1967. At our clubhouse on Prospect Avenue, Irish music, sport, and service bring neighbors together. The pub and kitchen are open to the public.

The club’s tradition of service includes the Frank Schott Blood Drive and fundraisers for childhood cancer research through St. Baldrick’s. On Friday and Saturday nights, local and regional musicians take the stage in the pub.
